name: Introduction to the Veterinary Profession
description: Students are introduced to the veterinary industry and profession by exploring the roles within a veterinary team, the legislation that governs their profession, and the ethical standards they must uphold. The course covers essential workplace policies, including safety protocols, risk recognition, and measures to protect themselves, the team, and visitors. Students examine the crucial role in recognizing and responding to cases of animal cruelty and abuse ensuring they fulfill their ethical responsibility in protecting animal welfare. Additionally, students learn about marketing strategies specific to veterinary clinics and how their role contributes to building a positive clinic reputation.
